scenarios: Pragmatic bilateral trade agreement with no fundamental Pix or BRICS alteration
Gradual BRICS payment interoperability without monetary union
Minerals and technology restrictions fragment supply chains and investments
Political dispute over Flavio Bolsonaro's US admission prolongs bilateral diplomatic friction
contrary_evidence: The official September 2026 BRICS declaration prioritizes interoperability and local currencies, not a single monetary authority.
Pix September 2026 domestic volume does not quantify the diversion of Visa/Mastercard revenue or dollar settlement.
The US-Brazil trade working group and documented minerals interest predate the October election and Flávio's departure.
US statements on 30 October indicate no current plan to recognize Flávio as Brazilian president.
Brazil formally contests the USTR Section 301 assessment; the US allegations remain attributed positions.
There is no documentary proof in the reviewed source set of an explicit protection-for-minerals or Pix concession exchange.
The prior MCS2026 Brazil rare earth reserve value of 21 million tonnes REO was revised in May 2026 to 11 million; the latest value is used in both charts and references.

Serra Verde's completed September USA Rare Earth takeover and 15-year US-backed offtake predate the October Brazilian election; they establish real ownership/contractual control but not a migration-for-minerals exchange.

producer_checks.research_depth: 30 numbered analytical chapters in each locale plus methods and references; PT-BR 9,253 and EN 7,468 whitespace-delimited words; updated section 15 reserve measurement, section 17 completed merger, and section 22 industrial bargaining counterfactuals.
producer_checks.source_check: 40 matching sources per locale including 8 new first-party/SEC sources: revised USGS factsheet and version history, Serra Verde February DFC statement, SEC financing and draw, Serra Verde August offtake, USAR SPV commitments, USAR Sept acquisition, SEC Sept merger consideration, Cade antitrust inquiry. Independent QA source-by-source audit required.

producer_checks.bilingual_parity: All 30 analytical chapters, 40 corresponding reference URLs, 9 visual types and 4 numerical chart series match. EN opening rewritten from broken report self-reference to two complete, direct institutional sentences. PT-BR source unchanged.
producer_checks.methodology: Cites latest revised USGS MCS2026 May edition, not stale February estimate. Separates mineral REO reserves from mining production and carbonate from separated oxide/magnets; US corporate ownership (Sept 3) from Brazilian territorial sovereignty, executed DFC facility from actual US$325m March drawdown, government funding commitments from conditional credit and future purchases. The pre-election industrial transaction does not prove an exchange for post-election Flavio US admission.
